title: Add configurable gesture sensitivity slider
description:
Allow users to adjust gesture detection sensitivity in Settings.

UI:
- Add slider to SettingsView (0.5x - 2.0x sensitivity)
- Default: 1.0 (normal)
- Lower = more strict detection
- Higher = more lenient detection

Implementation:
- Store in ConfigurationManager.gestureSensitivity
- Modify detector thresholds based on sensitivity multiplier
- Apply to all detector threshold values
- Real-time updates without restart

Affects:
- Finger extension thresholds
- Swipe distance requirements
- Temporal smoothing (frames required)

Acceptance: User can adjust slider and see immediate effect on detection.

title: Code signing and distribution preparation
description:
Configure code signing for distribution outside development.

Steps:
1. Configure Development certificate for testing
2. Set up Developer ID certificate for distribution
3. Configure entitlements properly
4. Test app signing: codesign -dv --verbose=4 MRGesture.app
5. Archive build (Product → Archive)
6. Export with Developer ID
7. Notarize app for macOS 10.15+:
   - Submit to Apple notary service
   - Staple notarization ticket
8. Test on clean Mac (no Xcode)

Commands reference in XCODE_SETUP.md.

Acceptance: App runs on fresh Mac without Xcode installed.

title: Wire up HandPoseDetector to CameraManager
Implement unit tests for gesture detectors
description:
Create unit tests for gesture detection logic using mock HandPose objects.

Test files to create:
- GestureDetectionTests.swift
- MockHandPoseProvider.swift

Test cases:
1. PeaceSignDetector - valid peace sign returns true
2. PeaceSignDetector - fingers not extended returns false
3. ThumbsUpDetector - valid thumbs up returns true
4. ThumbsUpDetector - thumb not extended returns false
5. SwipeDetector - upward movement detected
6. SwipeDetector - insufficient movement returns false
7. GestureRecognizer - temporal smoothing (3 frames required)
8. GestureRecognizer - cooldown behavior

Create synthetic HandPose objects with specific landmark coordinates for each test.

title: Performance profiling and optimization
description:
Profile app performance and optimize for CPU/GPU usage.

Tasks:
1. Run Xcode Instruments - Time Profiler
2. Measure CPU usage (target: <5% idle, <15% active)
3. Measure gesture latency (target: <100ms camera → action)
4. Profile memory usage - check for leaks
5. Test frame rate throttling (15 vs 30 FPS)
6. Monitor thermal impact on extended use

Optimization opportunities:
- Verify Vision framework Metal acceleration
- Check autoreleasepool usage in frame processing
- Confirm frame dropping works correctly
- Test circular buffer memory management

Tools:
- Activity Monitor (real-time CPU/memory)
- Xcode Instruments (Time Profiler, Allocations, Leaks)
- Console logs for timing measurements

Document performance metrics in issue comments.

title: Create Xcode project file (.xcodeproj)
description:
Create the actual Xcode project file by following XCODE_SETUP.md instructions.

Steps:
1. Open Xcode on Mac
2. Create new macOS App project
3. Configure bundle ID and team
4. Add all Swift source files from MRGesture/MRGesture/
5. Configure build settings (App Sandbox, Hardened Runtime)
6. Add entitlements (Camera, Accessibility)
7. Test build succeeds

Acceptance: Xcode project builds without errors

title: Implement horizontal scrolling (left/right swipes)
description:
Currently only vertical scrolling is implemented. Add horizontal scrolling.

SwipeDetector already detects left/right swipes but ActionDispatcher needs:
1. Handle .scrollLeft and .scrollRight cases
2. Test horizontal scrolling in browsers, Finder
3. Adjust scroll amount for horizontal (may need different value than vertical)

Implementation:
- ActionType already has scrollLeft/scrollRight
- ScrollSimulator.scrollLeft/Right already implemented
- Just need to test and tune

Low priority - vertical scrolling more commonly used.

title: Fix SwipeDetector gestureType dynamic issue
description:
SwipeDetector has a static gestureType property but needs to return dynamic direction.

Current issue:
- gestureType returns .swipe(direction: .up) always
- Actual direction is in private 'detectedDirection' variable
- GestureRecognizer can't get the actual swipe direction

Solution:
- Modify GestureRecognizer to handle dynamic gesture types
- Or have SwipeDetector return different instances per direction
- Or add a method to get the detected direction after detect() returns true

See SwipeDetector.swift:14 and lines 80-85

title: Manual integration testing - end-to-end gestures
description:
Perform manual testing of all gesture flows on real hardware.

Test matrix:
1. Peace sign → Alfred launches ✓
2. Thumbs up → Ghostty activates ✓
3. Swipe up → Page scrolls up ✓
4. Swipe down → Page scrolls down ✓
5. Menu bar Start/Stop toggles detection ✓
6. Settings window shows permission status ✓
7. Camera permission flow ✓
8. Accessibility permission flow ✓

Edge cases:
- No hand in frame → No false positives
- Low lighting conditions
- Multiple gestures in sequence
- Rapid gesture changes
- Alfred/Ghostty not installed (fallback behavior)
- Camera denied → Proper error message
- Accessibility denied → Scrolling disabled gracefully

Document any issues found.

title: Fix gesture recognition accuracy issues
description:
Tune gesture detection thresholds based on real-world testing.

Expected issues to address:
- Peace sign false positives/negatives
- Thumbs up detection reliability
- Swipe sensitivity tuning
- Lighting condition handling

Tunable parameters:
- PeaceSignDetector: fingerExtensionThreshold (currently 0.15)
- PeaceSignDetector: fingerSpread angle range (15-45°)
- ThumbsUpDetector: thumbExtensionThreshold (0.4)
- ThumbsUpDetector: minUpwardAngle (60°)
- SwipeDetector: minSwipeDistance (0.15)
- SwipeDetector: minVelocity (0.01)

Process:
1. Test in various lighting conditions
2. Test at different hand distances (1-3 feet)
3. Test with different hand sizes
4. Adjust thresholds iteratively
5. Document optimal values

May need to add configurable sensitivity slider in settings.

title: Documentation: Add screenshots and demo video
description:
Enhance documentation with visual aids.

Add to README.md:
1. Screenshot of menu bar icon
2. Screenshot of Settings window
3. GIF/video of gestures in action
4. Diagram of hand landmarks (annotated)

Recording demo:
- Record peace sign → Alfred launch
- Record thumbs up → Ghostty switch
- Record swipe → scroll action
- Create animated GIF with ffmpeg or screen recorder

Tools:
- Screenshot: Cmd+Shift+4
- Screen recording: Cmd+Shift+5
- GIF creation: gifski or similar

Store in docs/ or embed in README.

title: Add debug visualization mode (optional)
description:
Add optional debug mode to visualize hand landmarks and gesture detection.

Features:
- Show camera preview window (optional)
- Overlay hand skeleton on video feed
- Display detected gesture name
- Show landmark confidence values
- Real-time FPS counter
- Enable via Settings or menu item

Benefits:
- Easier troubleshooting
- Better threshold tuning
- Demo/presentation mode

Implementation:

- Draw landmarks using CAShapeLayer
- Text overlay for gesture name
- Toggle in Settings UI

Priority: Low (nice to have, not required for MVP)

title: Create app icons and assets
description:
Design and add app icons for MRGesture.

Required assets:
1. Menu bar icons (16x16, 32x32 @1x and @2x):
   - Active state (hand.raised.fill or custom)
   - Inactive state (hand.raised or custom)
2. App icon (1024x1024 for Assets.xcassets)
3. Add to Resources/Assets.xcassets/

Options:
- Use SF Symbols (hand.raised, hand.raised.fill)
- Design custom icons
- Ensure template mode for menu bar (monochrome)

Acceptance: Icons visible in menu bar and About dialog
